The following events took place in '''59 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Nejaa Halcyon]] and [[Scerra Horn|Scerra]] wed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] is kept a secret.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
*[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] first [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Feemor]] passes the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials]] and becomes a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Jinn becomes a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and takes on [[Xanatos]] as his second Padawan learner.<ref name="TPM:VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
*[[Wirt-cough]] epidemic starts from [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], then spreads to the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

==Births==
*[[Taroon (Rutanian)|Taroon]] on [[Rutan/Legends|Rutan]]<ref name="Shattered Peace">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Shattered Peace]]''</ref>
*[[Sheeka Tull]] on [[Atrivis 7]]<ref name="Cestus Deception">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref>
*[[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]
*[[Mikka Reekeene]]<ref name="CP">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref>

*[[Karl Mathieu Ancher]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]<ref name="SWAJ">{{JournalCite|3|When the Domino Falls}}</ref>
